SELECT
  SUM(s.net_amount) AS 净销额
FROM fact_sales s
JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
JOIN dim_outlet o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
WHERE d.year_month = '2026-08'
  AND o.region = '华东'

SELECT o.channel AS 渠道, COUNT(DISTINCT o.outlet_id) AS 有效终端数
FROM dim_outlet o
WHERE o.is_active = TRUE
GROUP BY o.channel

SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT r.outlet_id)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.outlet_id), 0) AS 铺市率
FROM dim_outlet o
LEFT JOIN rel_outlet_sku r ON o.outlet_id = r.outlet_id
JOIN dim_date d ON r.listed_date

SELECT
  o.outlet_name AS 终端名称,
  SUM(s.net_amount) AS 净销额
FROM fact_sales s
JOIN dim_outlet o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2

SELECT
  p.category AS 品类,
  SUM(s.qty) AS 销量
FROM fact_sales s
JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
JOIN dim_product p ON s.sku_id = p.sku_id
WHERE d.year_month = '2026-08'
GROUP BY p.category

WITH s AS (
  SELECT d.year_month, SUM(s.net_amount) AS amt
  FROM fact_sales s
  JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
  JOIN dim_outlet o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
  WHERE s.is_promo = TRUE

SELECT dl.dealer_name
FROM fact_sales s
JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
JOIN dim_dealer dl ON s.dealer_id = dl.dealer_id
GROUP BY dl.dealer_name
HAVING SUM(s.net_amount) > 1000000

SELECT
  d.year_month AS 月份,
  SUM(s.net_amount) AS 净销额
FROM fact_sales s
